title: Acquirer Detail
description: Contains additional details about the acquirer for a 3DS Authentication.

acquirer_bin.description: The Acquirer BIN (specific to the directory_server).

acquirer_country.description: The two-letter country code of the acquirer ([ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)).

acquirer_merchant_id.description: The Merchant ID (or Card Acceptor ID) that your acquirer assigned you (specific to the directory_server).

mcc.description: The [merchant category code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Merchant_category_code) as defined by each payment system or directory server.

merchant_name.description: The merchant name assigned by the acquirer or payment system. Same name used in the authorization message as defined in [ISO 8583](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8583).

requestor_id.description: Requestor ID if you’re enrolled in the card network’s 3DS program. Otherwise, you can omit this field because Stripe assigns a Requestor ID with the card networks.
